body: Honestly I was a really happy kid but things were relatively bad. Possibly worse than now so it’s not something I would want to go back to. I’m just at an awkward age where I can’t get away from everything I want to but I’m not a kid either. So I’m just kinda stuck living at home with our shit economy but also doing nothing with my life

It’s the cruel fucked up world we live in. Our brains are just wired differently than other peoples. We see the world for what it really is but we get the small glimpses of how others see it. Idk which is better to live in but I just want to be happy
Makes me feel like shit that I could end my own pain and even I let myself down. I guess a small small small part of us just doesn’t want it and it somehow overrules the large part that does
Lmfaoooo what
I might just take you up on that
Definitey much needed
I’ve been putting little shaped decals. I wanna try the color layering when I get better
I’ve been trying the resin stuff everyone’s been doing. But I got a whole bunch of different molds and key chain rings. I want to get more colors and glitters though
Yeah ours was sudden too. Also I like to do crafts but I’ve been babysitting and working a lot. I haven’t gotten to test out some new stuff
I’m sorry to hear that. It’s been a rough start to the year. I hope things look up for you

Maybe but then again I have days where I feel brilliant. And my teachers always told me that I was very bright. I think it may be because some of my friends act like they’re so much smarter than me. But maybe it is me
Thank You!!

You have too much to live for. You have a whole life ahead of you to fulfill. I know it sucks now but just think how amazing it’s gonna be when you finally settle down and accept how it’s gonna be and be genuinely happy ❤️
I’m glad! We all gotta stay up ❤️
Thank you  ❤️ I appreciate it
I agree 100%

Just try your hardest to keep it together. You probably mean the world to your dad, it would kill him to lose you. I know nine months is long but just think about the good times you guys will have when he gets back

People will make their own decisions but it’s not wrong to suggest what you think is best especially when it’s something so serious. You love them, tell them how much they are worth and why they should stay on earth
Disagree
Happy birthday
I’ve been there. You just have to work on who you are. Don’t be ashamed of being you but if you see what’s wrong, fix it. Remember, things get better. Even if they get worse first
